common.name: Name
common.readOnly: Read-only: only the department's managers can change this.

login.subtitle: Sign in with the username you got from your manager.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few seconds and try again.

errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this
errors.alreadyExists: This already exists (name, code or number must be unique)
errors.usernameFormat: Username: 3–40 characters, letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.rateFormat: Hourly rate must be a positive amount, e.g. 7.50
errors.adminOnlyReset: Only an admin can reset this password
errors.ownAdmin: You cannot remove your own admin access
errors.breakTooLong: Break is longer than the shift
errors.cannotEditSchedule: You cannot edit this department's schedule
errors.nothingToCopy: The previous week has no schedule to copy
errors.alreadyApproved: Some of these days are already approved. Reload the page.
errors.approvedMeanwhile: Someone else saved this in the meantime. Reload the page.
errors.notApprovedYet: This day is not approved yet – approve it normally
errors.correctionPending: A correction for this day is already waiting for approval
errors.reasonRequired: Write a reason for the change
errors.dayChanged: The day changed since this request was made – reject it and ask for a new one
errors.hoursWhole: {name}: hours must be a whole number
errors.notLinked: Your login is not linked to an employee record
errors.cannotRequestFor: You cannot request for this employee
errors.ownAdvance: You cannot decide your own advance
errors.swapPastDay: Days in the past can't be swapped
errors.swapTooFar: That day is too far ahead
errors.swapColleague: Choose a colleague from your department
errors.swapColleagueNoLogin: This colleague has no app login, so they can't answer. Ask your manager.
errors.swapDayApproved: One of these days is already approved in Forma 76
errors.swapNothing: You both have the same plan on these days – nothing would change
errors.swapOverlap: One of you already has an open swap request for one of these days
errors.swapNotYours: This request is not addressed to you
errors.swapExpired: This request has expired – the day has passed
errors.swapOwn: You take part in this swap – another manager has to decide
errors.swapStale: The schedule for these days changed after the request. Reject it and ask them to send a new one.
errors.advanceNotApproved: Only approved advances can be marked as given
errors.swapAbsence: Leave and sick days can't be swapped – only shifts and days off
errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.telegramNotConfigured: Telegram isn't set up on the server
errors.webhookNeedsHttps: Telegram needs the app's public https address (set APP_URL)
errors.noChannels: Add an email or connect Telegram first
errors.otherDepartment: That place or role belongs to another department

departments.title: Departments
departments.noManagers: No users with the Manager role yet (Users & roles).

employees.title: Employees
employees.rateHistoryHelp: Rates are never overwritten. Add a new rate with the date it starts; past months keep their old rate.
employees.resetHelp: The person gets a link to choose a new password. You never see or type their password.
employees.inviteHelp: The person gets a link to choose their own password (by email if given, or via Telegram / QR below).

shifts.title: Shift legends
shifts.help: Each legend is a code managers pick in the schedule. Overnight blocks (e.g. 23:00-07:00) are supported.

users.title: Users & roles
users.help: Managers, owner, accountants and admins. Employee logins are created on the employee page. Users are deactivated, never deleted.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intact: ✔ Integrity check passed: all {count} events are linked and unmodified.
audit.broken: ✖ Integrity check FAILED at event #{id}. The log was modified outside the app.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hintTool: Click or drag across cells to fill.
schedule.hintNoTool: Tap a cell to choose its shift. For many cells at once, pick a legend above and drag across them.
schedule.copyConfirm: Copy last week's schedule onto this week? Existing cells this week are overwritten.
schedule.publish: Publish ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}})
schedule.footnote: Cost = paid hours × hourly rate × employer cost factor ({factor}). ✓ = day approved in Forma 76. “*” = legend changed after this day was planned. Amber dot = change employees can't see until you publish.
schedule.pdfHint: Download the shown period as PDF, with a legend of the hours
schedule.saveAsLegend: Save as a new legend for this department
schedule.customHelp: Without saving, these hours still appear in the legend with an automatic code (P1, P2…).
schedule.customHelpNoSave: These hours appear in the legend with an automatic code (P1, P2…).

timesheet.title: Forma 76
timesheet.progress: {approved} of {total} approved. Hours are pre-filled from the schedule – adjust what really happened, then approve.
timesheet.futureNote: Days in the future cannot be approved.
timesheet.lockNote: After approval a day is locked; changes go to the top manager.
timesheet.sentForApproval: Sent to the top manager for approval
timesheet.unapprovedNote: {count} planned day(s) are not approved yet (shown grey in brackets). Only approved days count as actual.

corrections.title: Corrections of approved days
corrections.helpDecide: Approve or reject changes to days that were already approved.
corrections.helpManager: Changes you requested; the top manager decides.

budgets.title: Labour budgets
budgets.historyNote: Every change is kept in history; the latest value counts.
budgets.factorHelp: Gross hourly rate × factor = cost used in budgets. 1.19 ≈ gross pay + employer social contributions.
budgets.nothingToCopy: Nothing to copy (no previous budgets, or this month is already set)

dashboard.title: Labour cost
dashboard.unapprovedWarning: ⚠ {count} past employee-day(s) are scheduled but not approved in Forma 76 – they are counted from the schedule.
dashboard.footnote: Actual = approved hours × rate × cost factor. Projected = actual + scheduled hours of days not yet approved. Estimates, not payroll.
dashboard.unpublishedWarning: {name}: {count} upcoming schedule changes are not published – staff don't see them yet.

advances.title: Salary advances
advances.onBehalf: Request on behalf of an employee
advances.flow: Request → approved by the manager or accounting → marked as given by accounting.
advances.context: This month: earned so far {earned} · advances already approved {advanced}

me.title: My schedule
me.notLinked: Your login is not linked to an employee record.
me.estimateNote: Estimate only: hours × your hourly rate, before taxes and contributions. The final salary is calculated by accounting.
me.nothingThisMonth: Nothing published for this month yet.
me.tableHelp: Tap one of your coming days to ask a colleague to swap it.
me.tableHelpTeam: Tap a colleague's day to ask them for a swap. Only published plans are shown.

team.title: Team
team.monthHours: This month: {approved} h approved + {planned} h planned

swaps.title: Shift swaps
swaps.managerHelp: A colleague has already agreed to each swap below. Approving exchanges the two plans, and both people see the change straight away.
swaps.ownNeedsOther: You take part in this swap – another manager or the GM has to decide.
swaps.newHelp: Exchange your plan with a colleague for one day, or for two days. Your colleague accepts first, then your manager approves.
swaps.noLogin: no app login – ask your manager
swaps.secondHelp: For example: they take your Thursday and you take their Saturday. On each day you exchange plans.
swaps.afterSend: Nothing changes until your colleague and your manager both agree.
swaps.acceptHelp: After you accept, the manager decides. Until then your schedule stays as it is.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.help: We'll send a link to your email or Telegram.
forgot.sentIfPossible: If your account has an email or Telegram, a link is on its way (valid 2 hours). No message? Ask your manager.

account.title: My account
account.notificationsHelp: Get swaps, published schedules and decisions by email and/or Telegram.
account.emailOff: Email sending isn't set up yet – ask the admin.
account.telegramOff: Telegram isn't set up yet – ask the admin.
account.telegramHelp: Open our bot {bot} and press Start – that's all.
account.afterStart: After pressing Start in Telegram, come back here.
account.testResult: Email: {email, select, sent {sent ✓} failed {not sent ✗} other {–}} · Telegram: {telegram, select, sent {sent ✓} failed {not sent ✗} other {–}}
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

links.failedTelegram: Telegram message could not be sent
links.notSent: Not sent automatically (no email/Telegram yet) – give the person the link or QR below.
links.inPerson: Give it in person: scan or copy
links.linkValid: Works once. Invites last 7 days, reset links 2 hours.
links.telegramHelp: The person scans it and presses Start – the bot then sends the password link there too.

notifyAdmin.title: Notifications
notifyAdmin.help: Email and Telegram messages the app sends, and how they are set up.
notifyAdmin.emailSetup: Not set up: add SMTP_URL and MAIL_FROM to the server settings (see README).
notifyAdmin.telegramSetup: Not set up: add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME and TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (see README).
notifyAdmin.webhookOff: Not receiving messages yet – press the button (needs the public address {url}).

asked.subject: {requester} asks you to swap
asked.text: {requester} would like to swap with you. Open the app to accept or decline.

toApprove.subject: Swap to approve: {requester} ⇄ {colleague}
toApprove.text: {requester} and {colleague} agreed to swap. It needs your approval.

accepted.subject: {colleague} accepted your swap
accepted.text: {colleague} accepted. Now your manager decides – nothing changes until then.

declined.subject: {colleague} declined your swap
declined.text: {colleague} declined the swap. Your schedule stays as it is.

cancelled.subject: {requester} cancelled the swap
cancelled.text: {requester} cancelled the swap request. Nothing changes.

approved.subject: Swap approved: {requester} ⇄ {colleague}
approved.text: The manager approved the swap. Your schedule has changed:

rejected.subject: Swap rejected: {requester} ⇄ {colleague}
rejected.text: The manager rejected the swap. Your schedule stays as it is.

published.subject: Your schedule {from} – {to}
published.text: Your manager published the schedule. Your days:

requested.subject: Advance request: {name}
requested.text: {name} asks for a salary advance of {amount}.

approved.subject: Advance approved: {amount}
approved.text: Your advance of {amount} was approved. Accounting will hand it out.

rejected.subject: Advance not approved: {amount}
rejected.text: Your advance request of {amount} was not approved.

given.subject: Advance given: {amount}
given.text: Your advance of {amount} was marked as given by accounting.

requested.subject: Forma 76 correction: {name}
requested.text: A change to an approved day ({name}, {date}) waits for your decision.

approved.subject: Correction approved: {name}, {date}
approved.text: The change for {name} on {date} was approved.

rejected.subject: Correction rejected: {name}, {date}
rejected.text: The change for {name} on {date} was rejected.

setup.subject: Your login
setup.text:
Hello, {name}!
An account was created for you in the hotel's schedule app.
Your username: {username}
Open the link and choose your own password. It works once and is valid for 7 days.

reset.subject: Password reset
reset.text:
Hello, {name}!
A new password was requested for {username}.
Open the link and choose a new password. It works once and is valid for 2 hours.
If you didn't ask for this, ignore this message.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.text: Your password was just changed. If this wasn't you, tell your manager right away.

bot.help: This bot sends you messages from the hotel's schedule app. To connect, open My account → Telegram in the app.
bot.badLink: This link doesn't work any more. Open My account → Telegram in the app for a new one, or ask your manager.
bot.connected: Connected ✓ Hello, {name}! You'll get your schedules and requests here.

test.subject: Test message
test.text: This is a test. If you can read it, notifications work.

timeline.atLeast: at least at work the whole time {from}–{to}
timeline.full: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} there the whole time
timeline.part: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} only part of the time
timeline.badRange: Choose an end time after the start
timeline.help: Bars show who works when. The blue row counts people per half hour; tap a day in the week chart to see it.

setup.title: Locations & roles
setup.help: Set up the places (restaurants, bars…) and roles (waiter, helper waiter…) of a department. They are used to plan each place and to count staff per role.
setup.rolesHelp: Who does what. Each person has a usual role; it can be changed for a single shift.
setup.locationsHelp: Each place has its own schedule and PDF. The short code is shown in the grid.
setup.staffHelp: Filled in automatically when planning – can be changed per shift.

places.otherRoleNote: Not the usual role – these hours show up under “Hours by role”.

roleHours.title: Hours by role
roleHours.help: Hours worked in each role. Hours outside a person's main role are highlighted – they may be paid at a different rate.
roleHours.legend: Approved Forma 76 hours; numbers in brackets are planned and not approved yet. Highlighted: hours in a role other than the main one.
